subject.title: fix(media): allow Bedrock SDK auth for image and PDF tools

question: Should this PR land with the narrow Bedrock `aws-sdk` media-tool auth carve-out after the release-owned changelog entry is removed or explicitly accepted?
rationale: The code fix is well supported, but it changes credentials/provider behavior and the PR includes a release-owned file, both of which require maintainer intent rather than an automatic cleanup decision.

options.title: Approve after changelog cleanup
options.body: Land the auth fix and regression tests once the `CHANGELOG.md` entry is removed or explicitly confirmed as release-owned.

options.title: Accept as-is
options.body: Merge with both the auth-provider behavior change and the changelog exception owned by the maintainer.

options.title: Hold for a shared auth API
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want this fixed through a shared missing-key allowance abstraction instead of media-tool-local carve-outs.

recommendation.title: Approve after changelog cleanup
recommendation.body: Land the auth fix and regression tests once the `CHANGELOG.md` entry is removed or explicitly confirmed as release-owned.
